name: Small Cell Carcinoma of the Ovary, Hypercalcemic Type
aliases: Small Cell Ovarian Carcinoma Hypercalcemic Type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for SCCOHT

criteria.description: Presence of small round to oval malignant cells with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei on histopathology
Loss of SMARCA4 (BRG1) protein expression on immunohistochemistry
Ovarian mass with hypercalcemia in a young female patient

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of small cell carcinoma morphology with loss of SMARCA4 expression
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for SMARCA4 mutations can support diagnosis; hypercalcemia is common but not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ovarian mass detected by imaging or palpation
searchTerms: ovarian growth felt or seen on imaging

pathognomonic.notes: Elevated serum calcium levels due to tumor secretion of parathyroid hormone-related protein

common.symptomName: Abdominal distension due to tumor growth

searchTerms: pain in lower belly or pelvis
unintentional weight loss and poor appetite

laboratory: Anemia and leukocytosis in some cases
imaging: Large unilateral ovarian mass on ultrasound or CT scan
other: Histopathology showing small round blue cells with high mitotic index
Immunohistochemical staining positive for epithelial markers and negative for germ cell tumor markers

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of germ cell tumor markers (AFP, hCG)
Usually younger age group but distinct immunoprofile

redFlags: Rapidly enlarging ovarian mass in a young female
Failure to respond to standard ovarian cancer chemotherapy
references: Young RH et al. Small cell carcinoma of the ovary, hypercalcemic type: a clinicopathologic analysis of 150 cases. Am J Surg Pathol. 2014.
Witkowski L et al. SMARCA4 mutations in small cell carcinoma of the ovary. Nat Genet. 2014.
Orphanet: Small cell carcinoma of the ovary, hypercalcemic type (ORPHA:370396)
